name: form0-cli
description: Command-line tools for form0, the open-source schema-driven form ecosystem by paqu.io. Scaffold, validate, test and preview form schemas locally.

scripts.format: prettier --write "src/**/*.{js,jsx,json}" "bin/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs}" package.json README.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/publish.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "src/**/*.{js,jsx,json}" "bin/**/*.js" "tests/**/*.js" "scripts/**/*.{js,mjs}" package.json README.md SECURITY.md SUPPORT.md CONTRIBUTING.md .github/workflows/ci.yml .github/workflows/publish.yml
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm test && npm run smoke
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run security:audit:prod && npm run package:check

author: paqu technologies <hello@paqu.io> (https://paqu.io/)
